reviews.title: Overpriced for what it is
reviews.text: Not only do they want more money than a professional streaming service like Netflix or Hulu but they absolutely lie about how easy it is to watch the shorts for free and neglect to mention that the further into a series you get the shorter each clip gets, so the further you get into a series the more ads they force you to watch and since they limit the number of ads you can watch each day, the further into a series you get the less of the series you get to watch each day. At this rate, it’s going to take me over two weeks just to be able to finish the one series I’m trying to watch. I also forgot to mention that the length of the advertisements quickly become longer than the length of the clips they let you watch.

These updates the release have gone from good to bad tumors and the amount of content has gone from bad to good to greet but the ability to access it has become obsolete unless you are a native and can understand the Chinese Korean or whatever language language it is being spoken in. Subtitles are nonexistent at this point and it was promised after they finally responded to me a couple weeks ago that they had understood the issue after I had been required to do their own work for them to not only report the problem but then document and supply them with proof of the problem which was a chore considering the restrictions and screenshot it or recording due to privacy policies and they had promised me that they understood the issue with the program or application and the next update would fix it. 

Here we are now with the next update and it went from being a problem that was workable, (although frustrating which made me camp this application), to now being completely broken and something I will be unsubscribing to. This initial issue arose two months+ ago and they've only replied to me once during that period of time outside of telling me to do the all but impossible task of providing proof of the issue because they couldn't reproduce it. (That's laughable cause they found the issue cause supposedly quite quickly after proof was provided...yet obviously not considering the update just further broke things...sigh!)

reviews.title: Scam site
reviews.text:
I signed up for premium back in February but stopped using the account shortly after and forgot to cancel. I’ve been getting charged $20 a week ever since. The problem is, I can’t cancel it anywhere. It doesn’t show up in my App Store subscriptions or purchase history.

I contacted customer support and they told me they can’t cancel it on their end and that I have to go through the App Store—but it’s not there. So right now I’m being charged with no way to stop it. This needs to be fixed.

reviews.title: Getting charged twice
reviews.text: I’m not sure if this is some kind of a scam. I’ve been trying to cancel charges that I am getting on my card. When I want to subscribe I use in app Apple Pay and that comes up as an Apple charge. Since November I’m getting charge 2x a month  through stardustTV on its own. I’ve tried emailing and messaging support. I get no help. When I go through my bank, I can’t use my card for any purchases at all. This needs to be resolved and I need a refund. This is some kind of scam I don’t understand. I should only be paying when I have the subscription active so why is this happening? This is the most fraudulent thing I’ve ever seen. Hundreds of dollars at this point.
